confidence_notes: La Paz food prices are supported by mid-2026 to October cost-of-living aggregates. Cocktail pricing is based on a listed BOB 45 drink at an expensive-area venue; wine by the glass is inferred at roughly twice local draft-beer pricing. USD equivalents are uncertain given Bolivia’s exchange-rate differences. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and is the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No cross-city proxy used. Food and drink estimates use La Paz price aggregates; accommodation reflects a holistic estimate for a budget Andean capital and backpacker destination.
